senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; v. נָהַר) river, stream, canal.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:7">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> <he>נְהַר אש</he>, <he>נ׳ של אש</he> a river of fire (v. <cite ref="D00644"><he>דִּינוּר</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 16:4">Gen. R. s. 16</cite> <he>עד מקום שהנ׳ מהלך וכ׳</he> as far as the river (Euphrates) goes, goes the border of the land of Israel.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 6:1">Shebi. VI, 1</cite> <he>מכזיב ועד הנ׳</he> from Kezib to the river (N’har Mitsrayim); a. fr.—Pl. <he>נְהָרִים</he>, <he>נְהָרוֹת</he>. Gen. R. l. c. (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 2:10">Gen. II, 10</cite>) <he>והיה לארבעה נ׳ אין וכ׳</he> it does not say, ‘and it divided into four rivers’ but ‘into four heads’.

<cite ref="Bekhorot 55a:22">Bekh. 55ᵃ</cite> <he>כל הנ׳ למטה וכ׳</he> all other rivers are lower than the three (mentioned <cite ref="Genesis 2:11">Gen. II, 11</cite>, sq.), and these three are lower than the Euphrates; a. fr.—<cite ref="N00280"><he>נְהַר</he></cite> in pr. n. of rivers, e. g. <he>נ׳ פקוד</he>, v. respective determinants.
